title: Towards Accountability for Machine Learning Datasets: Practices from Software Engineering and Infrastructure
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a topic of analysis. The paper's primary focus is on establishing a rigorous, transparent framework for machine learning dataset development, maintenance, and accountability.
